question: Which of the following institutes conducted a PM2.5 air quality assessment in Indian cities in October 2025 and found that all ten of the most polluted cities were located within the National Capital Region (NCR)?

options.text: Centre for Sustainable Urban Climate Research
Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air
Indian Council for Environmental Data and Analysis
National Institute for Atmospheric Studies and Policy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA)** released an air quality assessment in **October 2025**, focusing on the concentration of **PM2.5** (Particulate Matter 2.5) across major urban centers in India.
 
• The assessment revealed a critical environmental situation where all **ten** of the most polluted cities in the country were located within the **National Capital Region (NCR)**.
 
• This concentration of high pollution levels in a single geographic belt underscores the regional nature of air quality crises in **North India**, especially during the onset of the **winter season**.
 
• The data for this study was compiled using readings from the **Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations (CAAQMS)**, which provide real-time updates on various pollutants. ***Hence, the correct answer is Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air.***
